results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Optional (if the correct property identifier is unknown or reports look empty)] [Prerequisite]: Identify the right property using GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_LIST_SITES (reuse the returned property identifier exactly).
[Optional (if access is uncertain or data is unexpectedly empty)] [Prerequisite]: Confirm the property is readable using GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_GET_SITE (avoid deeper pulls on an unreadable property).
[Required] [Step]: Retrieve sitemap inventory and health using GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_LIST_SITEMAPS (review pending status plus errors/warnings and submitted vs indexed when present).
[Optional (if a sitemap shows errors/warnings or submitted≠indexed)] [Next Step]: Get sitemap-specific metadata using GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_GET_SITEMAP (pinpoint the problematic entry).

[Required] [Step]: Pull aggregate performance totals/trends using GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_SEARCH_ANALYTICS_QUERY (start broad, then add dimensions/filters; paginate via start_row/row_limit; if 400 validation occurs, split queries and merge—optionally via COMPOSIO_REMOTE_WORKBENCH; treat missing/empty rows as “no activity in range”).

[Optional (if indexing/canonical signals are needed for priority pages)] [Next Step]: Inspect a small set of key pages using GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_INSPECT_URL (ensure the URL belongs to the same property; read nested status/canonical subtrees and corroborate neutral/unknown results).

[Optional (write; only if explicitly requested and confirmed)] [Fallback]: Resubmit a sitemap using GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_SUBMIT_SITEMAP (only after fixing the source and providing the exact sitemap location).
known_pitfalls: [GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_LIST_SITES] Multiple property variants can exist; using an inexact identifier often yields misleadingly empty/partial downstream results.
[GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_LIST_SITEMAPS] Numeric-like fields (errors, warnings, submitted, indexed) may be strings or missing; null-check and cast safely before comparisons.
[GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_SEARCH_ANALYTICS_QUERY] 400 invalid-parameter can occur for some dimension combinations; recover by splitting into separate queries and merging client-side.
[GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_SEARCH_ANALYTICS_QUERY] 400 invalidParameter observed with incompatible aggregation_type; remove/change it and retry (a valid response with no rows can still mean no data).

[GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_INSPECT_URL] 403 PERMISSION_DENIED can occur when the inspected URL is outside the chosen property; results may also be NEUTRAL/unspecified and should be treated as inconclusive alone.

reference_workbench_snippets.description: Compute deltas across two analytics responses in a multi-result payload
reference_workbench_snippets.code:
```python
import pandas as pd

def df(rows,label):
  return pd.DataFrame([{'k':(r.get('keys') or [None])[0],'c':r.get('clicks',0),'i':r.get('impressions',0),'p':r.get('position',0),'t':label} for r in rows])
cur=obj['results'][0]['response']['data'].get('rows') or []
prev=obj['results'][1]['response']['data'].get('rows') or []
m=df(cur,'cur').merge(df(prev,'prev'),on='k',how='outer',suffixes=('_cur','_prev')).fillna(0)
m['i_delta']=m['i_cur']-m['i_prev']; m['c_delta']=m['c_cur']-m['c_prev']
```

toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=google_search_console. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="google_search_console") to create a connection BEFORE executing any google_search_console tools.

GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_LIST_SITEMAPS.description: Lists all sitemaps for a site in Google Search Console. Response fields `errors`, `warnings`, `contents.submitted`, and `contents.indexed` may be returned as strings; cast to integers before numeric operations. Evaluate these fields alongside `isPending` for sitemap health.

site_url.description: The site's URL, including protocol. For example: https://www.example.com/ Must exactly match the Search Console property string — include trailing slash for URL-prefix properties or use `sc-domain:example.com` format for domain properties. An inexact match silently returns no data.

sitemap_index.description: A URL of a site's sitemap index file (e.g., http://www.example.com/sitemapindex.xml). When specified, lists the sitemaps contained within this sitemap index file instead of all sitemaps for the site.

GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_INSPECT_URL.description: Inspects a URL for indexing issues and status in Google Search Console. Results may reflect cached data lagging real changes by several days. High-volume use can trigger 429 quota errors; limit to priority URLs.

site_url.description: The URL of the property as defined in Search Console. URL-prefix properties must include a trailing slash. For example: https://www.example.com/

language_code.description: IETF BCP-47 language code for localizing the inspection results. For example: en-US, es-ES, fr-FR

inspection_url.description: The fully-qualified URL to inspect. Must be a page under the site specified in site_url. For example: https://www.example.com/page

GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_SEARCH_ANALYTICS_Q.description: Queries Google Search Console for search analytics data including clicks, impressions, CTR, and position metrics. Only returns URLs with at least one impression; missing rows do not confirm non-indexing. Position is an impression-weighted average rank.

end_date.description: The end date of the date range for the query, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

site_url.description: The site's URL, including protocol (e.g., https://www.example.com/) or a domain property (e.g., sc-domain:example.com). URL-prefix properties specify exact protocol and path, while domain properties aggregate data across all subdomains and protocols.

row_limit.description: The maximum number of rows to return. Must be between 1 and 25,000. Note: The API returns top results sorted by clicks (or date when grouping by date). Must be between 1 and 5000. Use start_row to paginate; stop when response rows < row_limit.

start_row.description: The first row to return from the result set. Used for pagination.

dimensions.description: The dimensions to group the data by. Results are sorted by clicks descending, except when grouping by date (sorted by date ascending).

start_date.description: The start date of the date range for the query, in YYYY-MM-DD format. Data lags 2–3 days (UTC); most recent 1–2 days may be incomplete. Data retention is ~16 months; older ranges return zero rows.

search_type.description: The search type to filter results by.

dimension_filter_groups.description: Optional filters to apply to dimensions. Each filter group contains an array of filters with structure: [{'filters': [{'dimension': 'country', 'operator': 'equals', 'expression': 'USA'}]}]. Operators: equals, notEquals, contains, notContains, includingRegex, excludingRegex. Invalid dimension names, unsupported operators, or mismatched expressions return zero rows without an error — verify each filter before trusting empty results.

GOOGLE_SEARCH_CONSOLE_LIST_SITES.description: Lists all verified sites (properties) owned by the authenticated user in Google Search Console. Response contains a siteEntry array — always iterate it, never assume a single object. Each entry includes permissionLevel, which varies per site; do not assume owner-level access for all returned properties. When calling downstream tools, use the site_url value exactly as returned, including protocol, subdomain, sc-domain: prefix, and trailing slash — any deviation causes empty results or permission errors. Empty siteEntry may indicate missing OAuth scopes or no verified properties. Newly added properties may not appear immediately due to propagation delay.
